verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server that connects meeting data to AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude. The docs give a server URL for any MCP-compatible tool, a Claude Code `claude mcp add` command pointing at https://api.fathom.ai/mcp, and an official Claude connector, and the probe confirms the MCP docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documentation of the specific tools/capabilities the server exposes.
